note: run settings only: every tolerance and evidence condition comes from the cell's acceptance file (plantcell/data/acceptance_v1.yaml), every other cell setting from the cell's own configuration; `time` and `budgets` are deep-merged over the cell's defaults (the practice ground runs the same numbers; the training hall caps its missions at 900 s simulated). program_time_cap_s caps the program's own time per mission: the wall clock minus the cell's simulation (step) and sensor rendering (get_camera, get_depth, get_thermal, get_lidar), which the sim cap and the frame budgets bound (cellkit.wire); cpu_cap_factor x program_time_cap_s = the program's CPU seconds; privileged_program_time_cap_s caps the oracle's missions, whose reference program steps the cell inside its one call
